_doc: Spirit beast companions (BEAST-001, Beasts system). A character who practises the Beast Tamer profession (any rank) and defeats an enemy listed as a beast's `enemy` may tame it: chance = tame.base_chance + tame.chance_per_rank * Beast Tamer rank, capped at tame.max_chance (min_rank: lowest Beast Tamer rank that may try). Each attempt gives tame.xp Beast Tamer xp. A character keeps at most max_companions beasts. Each companion adds its `bonuses` (fractions of the master's combat stats: max_hp, attack, defense, speed), scaled by (1 + rank_scale * Beast Tamer rank) and by outgrown_scale ^ (master's realm - the beast's enemy realm) once the master outgrows it, so stronger beasts stay useful longer. growth (BEAST-001d): feeding a companion an item from `food` ({item id: xp}) gives it xp; level = 1 + xp / xp_per_level (up to max_level), and each level above 1 offsets realms_per_level realms of outgrowing.
